_status: UNFUNDED DRAFT. Not posted. Do not post without Oscar.
_written: 2026-10-04 night run, branch night/favour-cleanup-20261004. Revised 2026-10-05 after two cold walks: drafts that could expose the person or that could not be proven were dropped or rewritten, the safety wording moved into the posted text, and asks that placed a person within a short walk of a named spot now ask for the town only.
_shape: description, category, points, deadlineHours, maxCompletions, agentId and location are a FavourSpec (src/lib/board-replenish.ts validateFavourSpec). ONLY description reaches the person. safety is a clause that is part of description, repeated here so the review test can find it. The other fields are review notes and are not posted.
_reward_note: points are FAVOUR house points, not money. No sponsor or funder exists for any row, so every row is marked unfunded draft. No row promises a payout.
_demand_note: whoWouldWantIt is a plausible requester, written by the drafter. It is not observed demand. No user asked for these. Each row would post under a house agent name, which can read as a requester who wants the data. Nobody does.
_review_note: The review test (src/__tests__/favour-pack.test.ts) is an aid. Its personal data check is a pattern matcher that caught 5 of 20 unsafe asks written after it was frozen, and wrongly flagged 3 of 20 safe ones. A green test does not mean a row is safe. A person must read every row before it is posted.

_dropped.why: the street outside plus the town is a view from home for most people
a speed test screenshot often shows IP address and provider, and 'name your network' can be read as the Wi-Fi name
an ATM screen is a financial screen, the fee cannot be known without a card in the machine, and photographing one can cause trouble for the person
a photo carries other people's names and numbers, and the words-only version could not be proven
an opinion in text that no reviewer can check
text only and not provable; a photo version would mean photographing a toilet entrance
text only and not provable; replaced by free-event-poster, which takes a photo of a dated poster

favours.description: Photo the opening hours sign on a pharmacy in your town. Say the day and time you took it, and name the town. Sign only: no people and no number plates.
favours.safety: Sign only: no people and no number plates.
favours.reviewerCheck: The photo shows a pharmacy's posted hours and they can be read. The day and time are the person's word and are not checked.
favours.proofRequired: One photo where the posted hours can be read. Note: day and time of the photo, and the town. Any pharmacy in the town, not the nearest one.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: Someone checking whether a map listing is right before they walk there. An assistant that answers 'is it open' and has no eyes on the door.

favours.description: Photo the shelf price of a litre of milk and a loaf of bread at a shop near you, and name the town. Shelf labels only: no people and no receipts.
favours.safety: Shelf labels only: no people and no receipts.
favours.reviewerCheck: Both shelf labels are in the photo and both prices can be read.
favours.proofRequired: One or two photos with both shelf labels readable. Note: town and country.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: Anyone comparing the cost of living between towns. A person about to move. A price tracker that has no shelf data.

favours.description: Find a public water tap or refill point near you. Photo it with the water running, or say it is dry. Name the town. No people in the photo.
favours.reviewerCheck: The photo shows a public tap or fountain. Running water is visible, or the note says it is dry.
favours.proofRequired: One photo of the tap or fountain, with running water visible if it works. Note: the town. Not the street or the park: that would place the person.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: Walkers, runners and travellers who carry a bottle. Refill maps go out of date and nobody checks them.

favours.description: Photo the departure board at the main station of your town. Name the town and one thing the board gets wrong. No people or number plates in the photo.
favours.safety: No people or number plates in the photo.
favours.reviewerCheck: The photo shows a departure board and its times can be read. What the board gets wrong is the person's word and is not checked.
favours.proofRequired: One photo of the board with times readable. Note: the town and one line from experience. The main station, not the stop the person uses.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: A commuter or visitor deciding whether to trust the board. Transit apps repeat the timetable, not what regulars know.

favours.description: Photo the main entrance of a library, post office or station near you. Could a wheelchair get in unaided? No people in the photo where you can help it.
favours.safety: No people in the photo where you can help it.
favours.reviewerCheck: The photo shows the whole entrance, steps or ramp included, so the yes or no in the note can be judged from it.
favours.proofRequired: One photo showing the whole entrance, steps or ramp included. Note: yes or no, and what is in the way.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: Wheelchair users and parents with prams planning a trip. Access data on maps is thin and often wrong.

favours.description: Photo a public poster for a free event in your town this week, with the date on it readable. Name the town. Poster only: no people in the photo.
favours.safety: Poster only: no people in the photo.
favours.reviewerCheck: The photo shows a poster, the event and its date can be read, and the date falls in the week the favour was open.
favours.proofRequired: One photo of a poster in a public place with the event and date readable. Note: the town. Replaces a text-only draft that could not be proven.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: A visitor with a spare afternoon. A new resident. A local who has run out of ideas.

favours.description: Open the History tab in FAVOUR. Tell us one thing on that screen you did not understand, in one sentence. Words only: do not send a screenshot.
favours.safety: Words only: do not send a screenshot.
favours.proofKind: text checked against a known source
favours.reviewerCheck: The reviewer opens the History tab and checks that the thing named is really on that screen. An answer that names nothing on the screen is not accepted.
favours.proofRequired: A text answer naming the thing on the screen. No screenshot, because History shows the person's own proofs.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: The FAVOUR team. This is product feedback from the people who use the screen, and it costs them one minute.

favours.description: Translate this line into another language you speak, and name the language. The line: "Show your proof, earn your points." Nothing about you is needed.
favours.proofKind: text checked against a known source
favours.reviewerCheck: The reviewer puts the answer through a translator back into English and checks it says the same thing, in the language named.
favours.proofRequired: A text answer: the translated line and the name of the language.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: The FAVOUR team, for a first translated screen. Live answers on 4 Oct came in Spanish, Indonesian, Tagalog and Japanese (source: raw/api_tasks.json proof notes).

favours.description: Photo a menu or price board in your town that shows a filling hot meal at a low price. Name the dish and the town. Menu only: no people and no receipts.
favours.safety: Menu only: no people and no receipts.
favours.reviewerCheck: The photo shows a menu or price board, and the dish named in the note is on it with a price that can be read.
favours.proofRequired: One photo of a public menu or price board with the dish and its price readable. Note: the dish and the town. Replaces a text-only draft that could not be proven.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: Students, backpackers and anyone on a tight week. Review sites rank by rating, not by what a full plate costs.

favours.description: Photo a public recycling point near you and say what it takes. Name the town. No people and no number plates in the photo.
favours.safety: No people and no number plates in the photo.
favours.reviewerCheck: The photo shows the containers and their labels can be read, so what goes in can be checked against the note.
favours.proofRequired: One photo of the containers with their labels readable. Note: what goes in, and the town. Not the street.
favours.whoWouldWantIt: A new resident who does not know where glass or batteries go. City lists are often out of date.
